linkTitle: In Memory of Rav David Ebner | When I learned of the passing of my Rebbi, Rabbi Dovid Ebner זצ״ל, it felt as though I had lost another parent | Facebook
linkDescription:
When I learned of the passing of my Rebbi, Rabbi Dovid Ebner זצ״ל, it felt as though I had lost another parent. He was, without question, the finest teacher I ever encountered.
I joined his shiur...

name: Ilan Regenbaum
story: He was my Rebbe for almost 20 years, and there are too memories to share, from our weekly chavruta on the Sfat Emet, to my wedding and other life events. I never had a way with words the way he did, so I will just share a few pictures.
